76593.subject: 👨🏻‍✈️ Claude CEO warns about dictators AI
76593.body:
----------

--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Anthropic's CEO described exactly what a dictator could do with AI, hackers took a Coca-Cola dairy offline this month, China published the biggest open model ever days after Washington accused it of theft and Dario finally said where Anthropic stands on open weights.



**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What could a dictator do with AI?

* **Cyberattacks:** Who got hit this month?

* **Moonshot:** What can you actually do with Kimi K3?

* **Open weights:** Is Anthropic for them or against them?


----------



----------
## [Anthropic's CEO on AI for dictators](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/anthropics-dario-amodei-responds-doesnt-oppose-open-weight-models-but-fears-chinese-ai/)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ef911e45-4c29-4ce4-ae2a-17e5e5cd6baa/Beehiiv_01_-_Jul_26.png?t=1785230842)
Caption: 

Dario Amodei spent this week explaining what an authoritarian government could do with powerful AI, and he was thorough about it.

Permanent military superiority over everyone else. Repression of your own people with no ceiling on it.

That ceiling is the part he keeps returning to in his own essays. A dictatorship has always needed people to carry out its orders, and people hesitate, leak and defect.

Machines don't. Run the surveillance and the enforcement through AI and the old limit disappears, which is how a regime becomes something you cannot vote out.

Sounds like he accidentally shared a feature list for dictators.

He named the Chinese Communist Party as the most capable government he has in mind, and said it isn't the only one.

He thinks the danger runs past cyberattacks into biological weapons, and he wants safety testing that even China signs up to.


----------









----------
_Special highlight from the network_

## [Who's Reviewing All That AI-Written Code?](https://utm.genai.works/r/ahdnpd7)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eb2aa7af-3d6d-4591-989a-6aba89970384/image.png?t=1785228717)
Caption: 

PR-AF ranks #2 of 42 on the Martian Code-Review-Bench, catching about 3x more real issues than the leading paid tools, at roughly 10x lower cost.

Built on AgentField, it runs on open or frontier models and drops straight into GitHub Actions with a single label — no new dashboards, no extra seats.

Fully open source under Apache 2.0

[See it on GitHub](https://utm.genai.works/r/ahdnpd7)


--

76591.subject: Block cut 40% of its workforce and then open-sourced Buzz, the AI Agent Workspace that makes it work 🤖🐝; Moonsho…
76591.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1105

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Tuesday! Today, we're diving into Block's Buzz, the open-source AI agent workspace Dorsey just released after cutting 4,000 employees (how it actually works, why calling it a Slack killer misses the ultimate goal, what Block's internal numbers say about running a company on AI agents + the Full AI OS to Run a Startup with Claude [ https://substack.com/redirect/cb3f3ca3-042e-4df9-b52c-b9283a3f94f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & How to Build and Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/9f70c568-7f2d-46e4-830c-9dfb4c06bc18?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, the first open-weight model in the 3-trillion-parameter class, already running on consumer GPUs (why the architecture matters more than the parameter count, what the license tells you about Moonshot's strategy, & how this changes the rent-vs-own economics for anyone building on frontier AI + the Ultimate Guide to Kimi K3 [ https://substack.com/redirect/1d5b2f98-a91c-4304-9f9d-7beac4bb1c03?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and DeepSeek’s AI Playbook  [ https://substack.com/redirect/2da34db3-16a5-44b7-b88a-3036e1c1b973?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]that erased $589B of Nvidia’s value [ https://substack.com/redirect/2da34db3-16a5-44b7-b88a-3036e1c1b973?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s jump straight into the finovative stuff 🌶️
Block cut 40% of its workforce and then open-sourced Buzz, the AI Agent Workspace that makes it work 🤖🐝
The news 🗞️ In April, Jack Dorsey and Sequoia’s [ https://substack.com/redirect/c714e999-85f0-4bbc-b360-7ebafa1511b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] Roelof Botha published a 3,000-word essay arguing that hierarchy is just an information-routing protocol, and AI can replace it [ https://substack.com/redirect/d106bf59-ef0a-404e-a35c-d91ea55aac15?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. The theory was sound. The messenger was not.
Remember that fintech giant Block $XYZ  had spent $68.1 million on a single company party in September 2025, then axed 4,000 employees just 5 months later. Ouch. The obvious question then was this: who handles fraud and accountability when you strip out the coordination layers where those things actually live? 🤔
On July 21, Block open-sourced Buzz, a self-hosted workspace built on Nostr where AI agents carry the same cryptographic identities, permissions, and audit trails as human employees.
→ It is designed to replace both Slack and GitHub with a single system where agents are not bots you summon but full members of channels who write code, run tests, review work, and hand off tasks.
